acceptanceCriteria: A component spec that queries a DOM node it created itself with no render of the subject is reported with the assertion line and value origin.
An enqueue/job expectation whose arguments match only values the test enqueued itself is reported.

An assertion on the subject's return value, rendered output or persisted state is not reported; an incomplete trace is advisory and says so; requirements in test-source-analysis-v0.md (lane-assigned TSA range); focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; build-log entry; Closes #1173.
body: GitHub #1173. Passing tests that assert on a value the test produced itself: a component spec querying DOM it built instead of rendering the subject; an enqueue expectation checking arguments the test enqueued itself; a fixture compared to itself after an action that never touched it. Requested: a data-flow check tracing the asserted actual value; report when its sources are only test-local literals/fixtures/built structures unreachable from the subject call or render; advisory when the trace is incomplete.
title: GH #1173: test-validity: flag assertions whose actual value comes only from the test itself (ASSERTED-VALUE-NOT-FROM-SUBJECT)
